title: 某研究团队在bioRxiv发表高脂饮食影响后代肠道-脑轴的机制研究
originalTitle: Perinatal high-fat diet induces systemic inflammation via altered tight junction complex organization during development and decreases expression of intestinal satiety peptides in male offspring.
summary: 某研究团队在bioRxiv发表高脂饮食影响后代肠道-脑轴的机制研究。成年雄性后代在孤束核（NTS）区神经支配减少，十二指肠胆囊收缩素（CCK）、胰高血糖素样肽-1（GLP-1）和肽YY（PYY）表达降低。
